_comment: Permanent stat potions for Omega Realm — the Glory sink. Holds consumables bought with account Glory that permanently raise a character stat (the deliberate counterpart to earning Glory via X->Glory conversion). The Go API (Postgres) is the authority for the Glory balance and the purchase transaction, and the Rust omega-server is the authority for applying the permanent stat increase in the live sim ('the client requests, the server decides'); this file mirrors definitions for client display/shop tooling and the server/API wins on disagreement. Governing GDD docs: ADR 0006 (docs/adr/0006-softcore-hardcore-glory-economy.md — Glory economy: Glory = floor(total_lifetime_XP/100), permanent stat potions as the Glory sink), data/balance/stat_caps.json (per-stat-potion caps). TODO: every potion and all costs/increments are unfilled pending design; the single example below is schema-shape only.
